directory.indexMetaDescription: Fiiri bogagga adeegyada dadweynaha ee SwapSpot oo loo kala qaybiyey qayb iyo suuq deegaan. Hel nadiifin, dayactir, guuris, tababar, daryeelka xayawaanka, quruxda, adeegyo xirfadeed iyo wax kale.
directory.indexTitle: Adeegyada caawiyayaasha deegaanka oo loo kala qaybiyey qayb iyo suuq
directory.indexIntro: Bogagganu waxay ka samaysan yihiin adeegyada caawiyayaasha la daabacay ee SwapSpot. Waxay ka caawiyaan macaamiisha inay helaan muuqaal dhab ah oo adeegyo ah iyadoo loo eegayo magaalo, koodh boosto, xaafad, qayb, qiimo, luqad iyo qiimayn.
directory.statPages: bogag qayb iyo suuq oo toos ah
directory.byCountryBody: Isku xir kasta oo hoose wuxuu furaa bog dadweyne. Marka caawiye daabaco aag adeeg oo cusub, halkan ayuu ka soo muuqdaa kadib marka kaydka goobta la cusboonaysiiyo.
directory.emptyTitle: Isku xirka adeegyada waa la diyaarinayaa
directory.emptyBody: Tusahan waxaa laga dhisay adeegyada caawiyayaasha la daabacay. Haddii aan wali isku xir halkan ka muuqan, dhawaan dib u soo eeg ama fur app-ka si aad u fiirisid caawiyayaasha u dhow.

directory.areaTitle: Aag deegaan, ma aha cinwaan sax ah
directory.areaBody: Bogagga dadweynuhu waxay muujiyaan xaafadaha, koodhadhka boostada, magaalooyinka iyo baaxadda adeegga si macaamiishu u helaan caawimaad u dhow iyagoon la muujin cinwaanno gaar ah.
directory.namesBody: Adeegyada caawiyayaasha waxaa loo habeeyaa cinwaanno la raadin karo, ereyo deegaan iyo bogag qayb si macaamiishu ugu raadsadaan shaqooyinka dhabta ah ee ay u baahan yihiin.
directory.inAppTitle: Sheekada iyo ballanku waa app-ka dhexdiisa
directory.inAppBody: Websaydhku wuxuu ka caawiyaa dadka inay helaan adeegyada. SwapSpot waxay qiimeynada, fariimaha, ballammada, dib-u-eegisyada iyo xakamaynta badbaadada ku hayaan app-ka mobilka gudahiisa.
directory.pairFaq1Q: Ma ka qabsan karaa ballan caawiyayaasha {categoryLower} ee {market} bogganka?
directory.pairFaq1A: Bogga websaydhkani waa muuqaal dadweyne oo loogu talagalay helitaanka. Soo dejiso SwapSpot si aad fariimo ugu dirto caawiyayaasha, u codsato qiimeyno, u wadaagto cinwaannada saxda ah, oo aad u maamusho ballammada.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Cinwaannada saxda ah ee caawiyayaasha ma yihiin kuwo dadweyne?
directory.pairFaq2A: Maya. SwapSpot waxay muujisaa aagagga adeegga ee qiyaasta ah sida koodhadhka boostada, xaafadaha, magaalooyinka ama baaxadda. Cinwaannada saxda ah waa gaar oo waxaa lagu wadaagi karaa sheekada kaliya marka labada dhinac ay diyaar yihiin.
directory.pairFaq3A: Maya. Caawiyayaashu waxay sameyn karaan bogga xogta oo liis garayn karaan adeegyo iyagoon bixin komishan ama boqolkiiba SwapSpot. Macaamiishu waxay bixiyaan helitaan marka ay rabaan inay fariin diraan, qiimeyn codsadaan, ama ballan qabsadaan.

maintenance.text: SwapSpot waxay u wareegaysaa serfarro cusub. Qiyaastii hal saac, galitaanka, dib-u-dejinta erayga sirta ah iyo isbeddellada akoonka laga yaabaa inaysan shaqeynin. Fadlan wax yar kadib mar kale isku day.
reset.title: Dib u deji erayga sirta ah
reset.intro: Dooro eray sir cusub, kaddibna gal app-ka SwapSpot adigoo isticmaalaya iimeelkaaga iyo erayga sirta ah ee cusub.
reset.repeatPassword: Ku celi erayga sirta ah ee cusub

reset.mismatch: Erayada sirta ah isma mid aha.
reset.done: Erayga sirta ah waa la beddelay. Fur app-ka SwapSpot oo gal.
reset.invalid: Isku xirkan dib-u-dejinta waa khalad ama wuu dhacay. Mid cusub ka codso app-ka.
reset.openLink: Si aad u sii wadato, fur isku xirka dib-u-dejinta ee iimeelkaaga.
reset.unavailable: Dib-u-dejinta erayga sirta ah weli lagama heli karo websaydhkan.
